simulated_buyer_return_P-02.experiment: Bench: adaptive valve vs fixed valve in mock CSF loop

outbound.claim: Adaptive valve reduces ICP excursion by 47.3% vs fixed

state_transition.rationale: Physical bench validation confirms the 47.3% computational prediction within confidence interval (45.7% measured vs 47.3% predicted, well within CI)

knowledge_atom_created.lesson: Adaptive valve profile achieves ~46% ICP excursion reduction in bench validation (confirmed computational prediction within CI)
knowledge_atom_created.action: Adaptive valve profile is validated for pre-clinical development

next_experiment_selected.rationale: P-02 now TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE. Next highest-information experiment: P-20 (IL-10 release, $5-10K, 6-8 weeks, HIGH info gain — validates anti-fibrotic mechanism)

state_transition.rationale: Physical bench validation contradicts the 47.3% computational prediction. Only 8.6% reduction measured. CI includes 0% (no effect). The computational model was wrong about the valve dynamics.

knowledge_atom_created.lesson: Adaptive valve profile computational model (47.3% prediction) was falsified by bench measurement (8.6% actual). The model overestimated the valve's ability to track ICP changes in real hardware.
knowledge_atom_created.action: Future valve candidates must include hardware latency in the computational model (real valve response time, not idealized)

next_experiment_selected.rationale: P-02 CEMETERY. Next highest-information: P-20 (IL-10 release, still pending, HIGH info gain)

machine_ingest.pass_fail_ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS (25.8% reduction, in 20-40% zone. CI spans both fail and pass thresholds)

state_transition.rationale: Insufficient statistical separation. CI [8.1%, 43.5%] spans both fail (<20%) and pass (>40%) zones. Need more data.

knowledge_atom_created.lesson: P-02 adaptive valve showed 25.8% reduction but CI was too wide to determine PASS/FAIL. Initial n=10 insufficient for this effect size.
knowledge_atom_created.action: Calculate required n from observed effect size and variance before repeating. For 25.8% effect with σ=2.8, need n≥30 for 80% power at α=0.05.

next_experiment_selected.rationale: P-02 AMBIGUOUS → repeat with n=30 (calculated from observed effect size). But P-02 repeat costs $10-20K. Compare to P-20 ($5-10K, HIGH info gain, untested). EIG analysis: P-20 has higher EIG/cost ratio.
next_experiment_selected.selected: P-20 IL-10 release assay (higher EIG/cost, then return to P-02 with n=30)

P-02_repeat.info_gain: MEDIUM (resolves ambiguous, but effect is modest)
